Model Text Summary:
A historical account honoring Major Somnath Sharma, the first recipient of the Param Vir Chakra (PVC). On November 3, 1947, during Operation Gulmarg, Major Sharma led D Company of 4th Battalion, Kumaon Regiment at Badgam, protecting Srinagar airfield from over 500 tribal infiltrators. Despite having an arm in plaster and facing overwhelming 7-to-1 odds, he commanded his troops, filled ammunition belts, and directed air support until killed by a mortar shell, successfully delaying the enemy advance.
